name: 承認対象と親作業の見出し
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Correct the heading block in image1 using ORIGINAL image2 for the slim chevron, optical type hierarchy and compact line spacing.
Make the right-facing breadcrumb CHEVRON much smaller and thinner: about8px tall,4px wide,1px stroke at logical666px component width, 5px after「資料を準備する」. It must match the original tiny thin angled stroke, NOT a thick rounded chevron.
Use actual Meiryo Regular12/16 for「礼拝の準備」, Regular14/24 for「資料を準備する」. These auxiliary texts are regular400, light optical weight. Main title「資料の確認」Meiryo Bold70020/28, not Black900, no synthetic extra thick outline. Keep the title readable and clearly larger.
Tighten vertical spacing to source-like: metadata baseline about20px, breadcrumb baseline46px, main title baseline82px. One white block666x106 logical px, left22px. Preserve all exact Japanese wording, left alignment, pure white canvas, no additional content. No border, cards, shadows, gray panels or icons apart from the one original tiny chevron.
reviewNotes: 訂正で小さく細い原本形状のシェブロンに改善。礼拝の準備／資料を準備する／資料の確認の全文、3段階の階層と白面を確認。補助2行通常・主見出しのみ太字。外側余白・厳密なフォント同一性、ネイティブ編集・アプリ動作は未証明。静的画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
